player_prompt.intro: O nṣere Blackjack lodi si onisowo. Ero rẹ ni lati sunmọ 21 bi o ti ṣee ṣe laisi lilọ. Ni akoko rẹ, yan '[Hit]' lati fa kaadi miiran tabi '[Stand]' lati mu. J/Q/K = awọn aaye 10; A = 11 tabi 1, eyi ti o dara julọ.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ìṣe tí kò léwu. Lo "[Hit]" tàbí "[Stand]".

game_message.all_complete: === Gbogbo {num_hands} ọwọ pari === Awọn Iwin: {wins}, Awọn Isonu: {losses}, Awọn Imuwe: {draws}

outcome.game_over: The game has concluded. Final scores: Dealer: {losses}, You: {wins}, Draws: {draws}
